obligations.summary: Providers must draw up technical documentation for high-risk AI systems before placing them on the market or putting them into service, keep it up to date, and ensure it demonstrates compliance with Section requirements and contains at minimum the elements in Annex IV.
exceptions: SMEs including start-ups may provide the elements of technical documentation specified in Annex IV in a simplified manner using the Commission-established simplified form, which notified bodies must accept for conformity assessment purposes.

obligations.summary: Where a high-risk AI system relates to a product covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I Section A, providers must draw up a single set of technical documentation containing all information required under both Article 11(1) and those applicable Union harmonisation legal acts.

The Commission must adopt delegated acts to amend Annex IV where necessary to ensure that technical documentation continues to provide all information necessary to assess compliance in light of technical progress.
